description: Check a UBL invoice or credit note against ANAF's own schema and CIUS-RO rules without filing it. Answers valid, and when not, findings: each with the rule it broke (e.g. BR-RO-001), where in the document, and ANAF's text. invoice is what the XML says it is, and file which file was read (name, size, sha256). Needs no grant. CII is not accepted: ANAF validates UBL only. The document goes as xml: { path } for a file, or { content_base64, sha256 } from a script.

xml.description: The invoice XML (at most 5 MB): { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.

name: validate_invoice
title: Validate an invoice with ANAF
